questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

10 ÷ 5 + 4 × 3 - 2 = 0
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f1f11fbb4e091305a6b414e74c3aec25b8d519670a1f3bd65f5bd4eb1bdcd68.png] 

Given equation: 10 ÷ 5 + 4 × 3 - 2 = 0

Option 1) - and =

After two signs should be interchanged:

⇒ __**10 ÷ 5**__ + __**4 × 3**__ = 2 - 0

⇒ 2 + 12 = 2 - 0

⇒ 14 = 2

Option 2) = and +

After two signs should be interchanged:

⇒ __**10 ÷ 5**__ = __**4 × 3**__ - 2 + 0

⇒ 2 = 10

Option 3) + and -

After two signs should be interchanged:

⇒ __**10 ÷ 5**__ - 4 × 3 + 2 = 0

⇒ 2 - __**4 × 3**__ + 2 = 0

⇒ __**2**__ - 12 __**+ 2**__ = 0

⇒ __**4 - 12**__ = 0

⇒ -8 = 0

**Option 4) × and -**

After two signs should be interchanged:

⇒ __**10 ÷ 5**__ + 4 - 3 × 2 = 0

⇒ 2 + 4 - __**3 × 2**__ = 0

⇒ __**2 + 4**__ - 6 = 0

⇒ **6 - 6** = 0

⇒ 0 = 0

Hence, the correct answer is "**× and -**".

• Moreover, IBM is tasked with the responsibility of conducting mineral beneficiation studies and development of mineral processing techniques. questions.question: The policy of Permanent Settlement was introduced in India in ____.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1793**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Permanent Settlement, also known as the Zamindari System__, was introduced in Bengal by the East India Company under Lord Cornwallis in 1793.
 
• The system was designed as a legal regime to stabilize property ownership and encourage the landowning Zamindars to improve the agricultural productivity of the lands they governed over.
 
• Its key feature was the fixing of tax obligations in perpetuity.
 
• The taxation rights were given to Zamindars, who were expected to collect these taxes from the peasant communities that resided on the land.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The Permanent Settlement was first introduced in Bengal and Bihar and later expanded to Varanasi and the south district of Madras.
 
• It eventually spread all over northern India courtesy of a series of regulations promulgated on 1st May 1793.
 
• These regulations persisted until the Charter Act of 1833 came to hold.
 
• The Permanent Settlement marked a significant chapter in the economic and social history of colonial India, shaping the contours of social power and land relations in regions it was introduced.

• Over the years, many judicial decisions and legislative measures have been influenced by the spirit of the Directive Principles.

• In the Constitution of India, fundamental duties are mentioned in Article 51A.

• the 42nd constitutional amendment added Part IV A and Article 51A to the Indian constitution.
 
• Initially, there were only 10 fundamental duties in the constitution.

questions.question: A principal of Rs. 40000 is invested at simple interest for 10 years. If the per annum rate of interest is 5 percent, then what will be the amount after 10 years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 40000

Rate of interest (R) = 5% per annum

Time (T) = 10 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

**Calculation:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (40000 × 5 × 10) / 100

⇒ SI = 200000 / 100

⇒ SI = 20000

Amount (A) = 40000 + 20000

⇒ A = 60000

**The amount after 10 years is Rs. 60000.**

questions.question: After a discount of 45 percent an article is sold for Rs. 1100. What is the marked price of the article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Discount = 45%

Selling Price (SP) = Rs. 1100

**Formula Used:**

Marked Price (MP) = Selling Price / (1 - Discount Percentage)

**Calculation:**

Let the Marked Price be MP.

Discount Percentage = 45% = 45/100 = 0.45

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 - 0.45)

⇒ 1100 = MP × 0.55

⇒ MP = 1100 / 0.55

⇒ MP = 2000

**The marked price of the article is Rs. 2000.**

**Given:**

A can build up a wall in 8 days.

B can break the wall in 3 days.

A has worked for 4 days alone.

B joined A for another 2 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work done by A in 1 day = 1/8

Work done by B in 1 day = -1/3

Remaining work = Total work - Work already done

**Calculation:**

Work done by A in 4 days = 4 × 1/8

⇒ Work done by A in 4 days = 4/8 = 1/2

Remaining work after A has worked for 4 days = 1 - 1/2 = 1/2

Combined work done by A and B in 1 day = 1/8 - 1/3

Work done by A and B in 2 days = 2 × (-5/24)

⇒ Work done by A and B in 2 days = -10/24 = -5/12

Remaining work after A and B worked for 2 days = 1/2 - (-5/12)

⇒ Remaining work = 1/2 + 5/12 = 6/12 + 5/12 = 11/12

Time taken by A to build the remaining work = (Remaining work) / (Work done by A in 1 day)

⇒ Time taken by A = (11/12) / (1/8)

⇒ Time taken by A = 11/12 × 8/1

⇒ Time taken by A = 88/12

⇒ Time taken by A = 22/3 days

**The correct answer is option 1.**
